# Dubai Land Department

> > Official portal for Dubai Land Department (DLD), providing real estate registration, property verification, RERA regulatory services, and Golden Visa applications for investors in Dubai.

The Dubai Land Department is the government authority responsible for regulating Dubai's real estate sector through RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Agency), managing property title deeds, and facilitating investor services including Golden Visa applications. The department leverages digital services and AI-powered assistants like Malik to streamline property transactions and regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- Dubai Land Department (DLD)
- Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA)
- Title Deed Verification
- Golden Visa for Investors
- Malik Virtual Assistant
- Property Registration
- Real Estate Tokenization
- Dubai Real Estate Market
- PRYPCO (Property Development)
- Tayseer Initiative
- Barwah Program
- Dubai Real Estate Brokers Program
- Real Estate Evolution Space (REES)
- Community Development Authority
- MENA Real Estate

## Core Services & Homepage

- [Dubai Land Department - Home](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/): Dubai Land Department homepage for property registration & services

## Property Verification & Title Deeds

- [Dubai Land Department - Verify Title Deed](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/title-deed-verification-overview/title-deed-verification/): Online title deed verification service for Dubai properties

## Real Estate Regulatory Services (RERA)

- [Dubai Land Department - RERA](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/rera/): Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA) services and virtual assistant

## Investor Services & Golden Visa

- [Dubai Land Department - Golden Visa application - Investor](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/request-for-golden-visa-investor/): Golden Visa application service for real estate investors in UAE
